title: The Wizard of Oz · 1. The Cyclone
source: Retold from L. Frank Baum, The Wonderful Wizard of Oz (1900), public domain. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/55

text: Dorothy lived in the middle of the great Kansas prairies with Uncle Henry, Aunt Em, and her little black dog, Toto.
Everything around the small farmhouse was gray, but Toto made Dorothy laugh every day.
pages.alt: Dorothy and Toto on the gray Kansas prairie

text: One day the sky grew dark, and a low wail came from the north.
"A cyclone is coming!" cried Uncle Henry. "Run for the cellar!"
pages.alt: A cyclone comes across the prairie

text: Toto was frightened and hid under the bed.
By the time Dorothy caught him, the house was shaking, and it was too late to reach the cellar.
pages.alt: Dorothy chases Toto as the house begins to shake

text: The cyclone lifted the whole house high into the air and carried it far away.
Dorothy hugged Toto, and after many hours she fell fast asleep.
pages.alt: The cyclone carries the house through the sky

text: Dorothy woke with a bump. The house had landed in a beautiful country full of flowers and fruit trees.
Little people in blue hats came to meet her. They were the Munchkins.
pages.alt: The Munchkins in blue hats greet Dorothy

text: A kind old woman stepped forward. "I am the Good Witch of the North," she said.
"Your house landed on the Wicked Witch of the East. She is gone, and the Munchkins are free!"
pages.alt: The Good Witch of the North talks to Dorothy

text: The witch gave Dorothy a pair of silver shoes.
"They have a magic power," she said, "but no one knows what it is."
pages.alt: The Good Witch gives Dorothy the silver shoes

text: "How can I get back to Kansas?" asked Dorothy.
"Go to the Emerald City and ask the great Wizard of Oz," said the witch. "Follow the road of yellow brick."
pages.alt: The yellow brick road leads toward the Emerald City

questions.ask: What did the Good Witch give Dorothy?
What should Dorothy follow to the Emerald City?
